articles.summary: The best strategy for retail IPO participation is to treat any IPO as a small, deliberate position inside a diversified portfolio, not a shortcut to fast gains. Research the company’s real business and financials, decide in advance how much you are willing to risk, keep any single IPO to a small share of your holdings, and build the position gradually rather than chasing the first-day price spike.
